verdict.rationale: Buzz is a chat and collaboration platform, so retention and deletion controls are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, message or data deletion, or purge controls. Self-hosting (you own the relay, Postgres, and S3 storage) and the branch-protection `--no-delete` flag are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
